name: Crew Neck - Smile High Club - Teal
description:
The Smile High Club Crew Neck Sweatshirt brings a clean pop of color with a relaxed streetwear vibe. Featuring a soft teal cotton body sweatshirt with subtle chest artwork and drip-style detailing, and loud Smile High Club text graphic on the back, this piece is designed for easy everyday wear while still making a statement.

Features:• Butter soft cotton construction• Teal long sleeve crew neck sweatshirt colorway• Smile High Club back graphic• Relaxed fit• Lightweight everyday feel
